Feature 1: Compact Header Mode (Responsive)

🎯 Design Specification

Goal: Reduce header height from 125px → 48px (without labels) or 145px → 68px (with labels) to double visible row count on laptop screens while preserving metadata access.

Implementation Pattern: Container query-based responsive scaling with manual density controls.

✅ Code Evidence Found

// Line 8-9: Constants defined
const HEADER_HEIGHT_COMPACT_BASE = 48;   // without labels compact
const HEADER_HEIGHT_COMPACT_LBL  = 68;   // with labels compact

// Line 2827-2828: State management
const [headerDensity, setHeaderDensity] = useState(() => 
  localStorage.getItem('dtsmartr-header-density') || 'auto');

// Line 3500-3512: Dynamic height calculation
const HEADER_HEIGHT = useMemo(() => {
  const isDetailed = headerDensity === 'detailed' || (headerDensity === 'auto' && wrapH >= 600);
  const isCompact = headerDensity === 'auto' && wrapH < 600;
  const isMinimal = headerDensity === 'minimal';
  
  if (isMinimal) return (showLabels && hasAnyLabel) ? 48 : 32;
  if (isCompact) return (showLabels && hasAnyLabel) ? 68 : 48;
  return (showLabels && hasAnyLabel) ? HEADER_HEIGHT_LBL : HEADER_HEIGHT_BASE;
}, [headerDensity, wrapH, showLabels, hasAnyLabel]);

// Line 3596-3634: UI Controls (3-button toggle group)

Feature 3: Shift+Click Multi-Column Sorting

🎯 Design Specification

Goal: Deprecate modal sort dialog in favor of Shift+Click to add columns to sort chain, with numbered emoji badges (1️⃣, 2️⃣, 3️⃣) showing priority.

Implementation Pattern: Click = replace sort, Shift+Click = add to sort chain, badges show priority.

✅ Code Evidence Found

// Line 2809: Sort state as array
const [sortState, setSortState] = useState([]); // [{ id, desc }]

// Line 2504: Click handler with shiftKey detection
onClick={(e) => {
  e.stopPropagation();
  onSort(meta.name, e.shiftKey);
}}

// Line 3440-3487: handleSort implementation with Shift logic
if (shiftKey) {
  if (idx > -1) {
    // Update existing sort in chain
    if (next[idx].desc === false) {
      next[idx] = { id: col, desc: true };
    } else {
      next.splice(idx, 1); // Remove on 3rd click
    }
  } else {
    return [...prev, { id: col, desc }]; // Add to chain
  }
}

// Line 2444-2448: Numbered emoji badges
const numberEmojis = ['1️⃣', '2️⃣', '3️⃣', '4️⃣', '5️⃣', '6️⃣', '7️⃣', '8️⃣', '9️⃣'];
const priorityBadge = sortPriority && sortPriority <= 9
  ? numberEmojis[sortPriority - 1]
  : sortPriority ? `[${sortPriority}]` : '';

// Line 3565-3577: Toolbar sort chain display
{sortState.map((item, idx) => (
  <span>↕ {item.id} {item.desc ? 'desc' : 'asc'} ({idx + 1})</span>
))}

Blocker/Showstopper Criteria

❌ FAIL if: 1. Compact mode breaks column header layout 2. Side panel crashes on rule add/remove 3. Multi-sort doesn’t actually reorder data 4. Live preview highlights wrong rows 5. Sort badges overlap column names 6. Keyboard shortcuts conflict with browser defaults

Expected Outcome

✅ PASS if all test cases marked with checkboxes return expected behavior.
⚠️ PARTIAL if 1-3 minor visual issues found.
❌ FAIL if any blocker found.
